text_block_list.text:
In the hallway, I saw Satono Diamond
chatting with her friends.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Satono-chan!?
They said a weird animal showed up in the fields!
Did you know?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
There are even rumors that it might be the famous
cryptid, the Silver-Scaled Giant Dragon Cicada!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Haa, that sounds quite tough as well...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...A-Are you okay, Satono-chan?
Your reaction seems a bit more subdued than usual...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, I'm alright!
I'm so sorry, I was spacing out..."
Such a muted reaction is so unlike the usually curious Satono Diamond... She's had a streak of races lately, so it might be best to review her race schedule.
